Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Subject: Inference rollout timing — quick recap & one ask

Hi Samira — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call + one small ask so I can align the right pilot plan:

Call highlights:
- PlatinumAI wants a short pilot (2 weeks) to validate throughput and latency for batch scoring and a low-latency interactive endpoint.
- Primary constraints: mixed CPU/GPU inference currently in pipeline, compliance requirement for data retention logs, and budget cap for Q3.
- Success criteria you mentioned: <10% latency regression vs baseline and <20% per-token cost uplift during burst windows.

Proposed next steps:
1) Pilot scope: 1 model (bert-embed variant) + 2 endpoints (batch, real-time) — pilot scope attached.
2) Timeline: kick off in the week of Aug 9, run two-week validation.
3) Ask: can you confirm whether this still maps to your Q3 roadmap window? If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff and loop in our solutions engineer.

If it’s not a fit right now, one sentence is fine — e.g., "we're delaying this work to Q4" — that helps me prioritize follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood-demo-recap.pdf, pilot-scope.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/30m

- Narrowed pilot to the two most representative endpoints to keep cost predictable.
- Included a short checklist in the attached pilot-scope.xlsx so your platform and security teams can scan requirements quickly.

If it helps, here are three options for quick next steps:
- Yes, let’s kick off Aug 9: I’ll send the invite and scope with an SE.
- Delayed: tell me which month works and I’ll reframe the cadence.
- Not a fit: reply "no-go" and I’ll close the loop (no hard feelings).

Calendar: https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/30m

Appreciate any quick clarity — even a single sentence helps.
